text.en: Fictional sample event: the fictional issuer announced a mock refinancing that pushes its loan maturities out to 2031.
text.id: Peristiwa contoh fiksi: penerbit fiktif mengumumkan refinancing pura-pura yang memundurkan jatuh tempo pinjaman ke 2031.
text.zh: 虚构样本事件：该虚构发行人宣布模拟再融资，将贷款到期日延至 2031 年。
